# Modules that boot a real system/v4 in tests WITHOUT using systemscenario.
# Generated by: bash scripts/check-systemscenario-adoption.sh --update
# (re-run it to re-measure; this file is hand-reviewed, so reasons survive)
#
# Every row is a deliberate choice, so every row needs a REASON:
#   <module><TAB><why the lower-level boot is the right tool here>
# A module that adopts the harness disappears from this list; the gate fails on
# an unlisted offender, on a stale row, and on an empty reason.
#
# module	reason
benchkit/v4	benchmark fixtures boot a system/v4 to measure latency; the assertions are metric-based, not behavioral
cmd/doc-check/v4	compiles documentation fences; the boot proves the snippet runs, and the fence text is the assertion
metaengine/v4	the auto-projection spike proves one wiring path; metaengine/v4's own suites are engine-level conformance
system/v4	unit-level tests for the composition root itself; the system-level BDD tier lives in systemscenario/v4/systemtest
system/integration/v4	real-engine integration/v4 legs (duckdb/postgres) assert engine wiring the scenario/v4 DSL does not model
systemcatalog/v4	derivation tests boot an ephemeral system/v4 to read registration records; no dispatch and no fold
systemtest/v4	crash/shutdown/durability paths; the DSL models behavior, these model process death and restart
